score_convention: higher = more likely fake; label 1 = spoof / fake

sampling.spoof_sampling: spread evenly over the attacks of the split

clip_score: pellav2: mean of the window probabilities; pellav2_max: highest window; lcnn: calibrated probability
lcnn_verdict_rule: LCNN spoof probability p: authentic if p < 0.4170, flagged (AI-generated) if p >= 0.5770, inconclusive otherwise; heuristic signals carry no weight

pellav2_dev_verdict_config.purpose: pellav2 audio verdict rule (AUDIO_PELLAV2_IN_VERDICT=true), fixed on ASVspoof 2019 LA dev only
pellav2_dev_verdict_config.threshold_rule: threshold = 0.5, the authors' operating point (pellav2_infer.py), fixed before any scoring; the ASVspoof 2019 LA dev sample only checks it (its EER threshold is reported, not used: the scores saturate near 0 and 1, so the EER point falls anywhere in the gap between the classes); inconclusive band = the platform default UNCERTAIN_BAND (0.08), fixed in advance and not tuned on audio
pellav2_dev_verdict_config.decision_rule: pellav2 probability p: authentic if p < 0.4200, flagged (AI-generated) if p >= 0.5800, inconclusive otherwise; heuristic signals carry no weight

dev_sample.note: dev holds only the training attacks A01-A06; these numbers are optimistic

latency_seconds_per_clip.note: pellav2 forward pass incl. preprocessing, file decoding excluded

codec_robustness.decode: ml/preprocessing/audio_codecs.encode_decode (ffmpeg to 16 kHz PCM, or soxr/ffmpeg round trip)
